description: Open-data facts at one full London postcode (e.g. "E17 4QH"): the Environment Agency flood zone at its centre; whether its centre is inside a conservation area, listed building outline, Article 4 direction area or tree preservation order area (planning.data.gov.uk, with "unknown" where the borough publishes no data); its Census neighbourhood's police.uk crime rate per 1,000 residents against London, Index of Multiple Deprivation decile and housing tenure; the nearest state schools with their own Ofsted grade and the nearest stations, by straight-line distance; door-to-door commute minutes from its postcode sector to 12 work hubs; council tax bands for its borough; and its district page. Every block says which area it describes; a single home can differ.

postcode.description: A full London postcode, e.g. "E17 4QH" or "sw112ar".
